title: Atomic org invite accept + revocation

evidence: Migration 20260909195618 adds token hashing, atomic invoker-rights acceptance, recipient acceptance RLS, revocation state/RPC, and a validation manifest.
Focused contract tests passed; local live RLS replay was unavailable because Docker was not running.

Live probe 2026-09-09 (local Supabase DB at 127.0.0.1:54322, migration applied as last of 281): PASS revocation (admin revoke flips revoked_at/revoked_by), PASS revoked-invite accept denial (invalid_token), PASS cross-user denial (random user sees 0 invites, RPC raises invalid_token), PASS replay denial (already-accepted invite cannot re-accept), PASS anon denial (RPC raises not_authenticated before body), PASS token hashing (unique org_invites_token_hash_key, no plaintext), PASS no-overwrite (existing member stays member while invite marked accepted), PASS guard immutability (direct UPDATE of accepted_at raises org_invite_acceptance_invalid). FAIL primary accept path (see blockers).

RE-PROBE 2026-09-09 (after ORG-004 migration 20260910000000 applied manually; local DB supabase_db_tourify-beta, 288/288 recorded): P1 first-time-recipient acceptance ATOMIC ACCEPT PASS (invite accepted + org_members row created in the single RPC call), P2 no-overwrite PASS (member role/row unchanged on re-accept; count stays 1), P3 replay denial PASS (already_accepted or invalid_token; invite stays accepted, no duplicate member), P4 revocation flips state PASS (revoked_at/revoked_by set by admin), P5 revoked-invite accept denial PASS (revoked or invalid_token; no member row), P6 cross-user denial PASS (email_mismatch or invalid_token; no member row), P7 anon denial PASS (both RPCs denied before body), P8 token hashing PASS (partial unique index present; no plaintext token), P9 guard immutability PASS (direct privileged UPDATE of role raises org_invite_immutable; acceptance direct-update raises org_invite_acceptance_invalid).

Retained probe harness /tmp/org003_probe.sql (re-run as postgres after fix): P1 PASS, P2 PASS, P4 PASS, P7 PASS (accept+revoke), P8 PASS. Its P3/P5/P6 notices report 'unexpected: invalid_token' and P9 reports 'overwrite succeeded' where RLS filters the invite row before the RPC/trigger can raise (invalid_token IS the documented ORG-003 denial semantics; P9's v_invite_id points at P4's revoked invite, which is invisible to the recipient under org_invites_accept_recipient USING). Authoritative order-independent re-probe supersedes these harness artifacts.

Verification commands PASS: check:migration-chain (288 files, no duplicate policies), check:migration-validation (ORG-003 + ORG-004 manifests scanned), check:database-types (no drift), focused vitest 2 files/4 tests PASS.

Route guard inspection (unchanged): POST /api/orgs/invite/accept auth-gated + rate limited 10/60s (user.id + client key); POST /api/orgs/invite/revoke auth-gated + rate limited 20/60s. Route-level 429/auth-window remains non-observable live because REST/auth containers are stopped (DB container only); release-gate item.

progress.summary: COMPLETE. All ORG-003 probe checks P1-P9 pass against the live local stack after ORG-004 applied migration 20260910000000 (accept_org_invite recreated with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, no arbiter target). The circular-RLS blocker on first-time recipient acceptance is resolved; atomic accept, hashed tokens, revocation, and rate limiting are live-proven.
completed: Live proof executed: revocation, revoked-denial, cross-user denial, replay denial, anon denial (not_authenticated raised inside both RPCs), token hashing, no-overwrite, guard immutability all PASS.

Definitive root cause isolated: INSERT INTO org_members plain succeeds; INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (org_id,user_id) DO NOTHING fails 42501 with members_select (is_org_member) applied to the not-yet-member row; INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING (no arbiter target) succeeds. The explicit conflict target makes RLS circular for first-time recipients.
Accept/revoke API routes confirmed auth-gated and rate limited (org-invite-accept 10/60s, org-invite-revoke 20/60s, keyed by user id + client key).

RE-PROBE (ORG-004): migration 20260910000000 applied manually (psql single transaction + supabase migration repair bookkeeping; 288/288) and full P1-P9 set re-run green: first-time accept, no-overwrite, replay denial, revocation, revoked denial, cross-user denial, anon denial, token hashing, guard immutability all PASS.
Repository checks green: migration-chain, migration-validation (ORG-003 + ORG-004 manifests), database-types, and focused vitest (4 tests).
next_steps: Release-gate check: observe route-level 429 rate-limit and auth-window live once REST/auth containers are up.

Optional follow-up: accept_org_invite returns organizer_account_id NULL for first-time recipients when no policy allows a brand-new member to see the org's (non-public) organizer_accounts row; decide on a security-definer helper or new-member visibility policy.
blockers: RESOLVED 2026-09-09 by ORG-004 (migration 20260910000000): P1 accept_org_invite defect (42501: new row violates row-level security policy for table org_members at ExecWithCheckOptions execMain.c:2146) - the insert on conflict (org_id, user_id) do nothing evaluates members_select=is_org_member(auth.uid(), org_id) against the row being inserted; first-time recipient is not yet a member, so is_org_member=false and RLS rejects the insert. Fixed by recreating accept_org_invite with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING (no arbiter); re-probed P1-P9 all PASS.
Route-level rate-limit 429 and auth window not observable live: REST/auth containers stopped; only DB container is up. Release-gate check (still open; not a code defect).
